features.title: Services
features.answer: ZuiGO's current website presents five practice areas on its home page: Healthcare Software Solutions, AI & Machine Learning, Fintech Software Solutions, Custom Software Development, and Cloud & DevOps Solutions.

features.title: Healthcare Software Solutions
features.answer: ZuiGO describes Healthcare Software Solutions as custom software for providers, patients, and healthcare organizations. The page highlights interoperable health data systems, patient engagement platforms, telemedicine and remote care, and healthcare analytics/reporting. It lists EHR/EMR and patient-portal builds engineered to HIPAA controls, telemedicine and remote-monitoring applications, HL7/FHIR integrations, and analytics dashboards with automated compliance reporting. Its representative technology set is React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, FHIR/HL7, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker.

features.title: AI & Machine Learning
features.answer: ZuiGO describes AI & Machine Learning as custom AI solutions that automate processes, generate insights, and drive intelligent decision-making. The page lists outcomes including intelligent process automation, predictive insights, natural language and computer vision, scalable ML pipelines, and responsible AI & governance. It lists production ML models with serving APIs and monitoring, LLM apps such as RAG, agents and copilots with guardrails, data & MLOps pipelines, and model evaluation/drift/governance documentation. Its representative technology set is Python, PyTorch, Claude / OpenAI APIs, LangChain, Vector DBs, FastAPI, MLflow, AWS / GCP.

features.title: Fintech Software Solutions
features.answer: ZuiGO describes Fintech Software Solutions as secure financial technology platforms for payments, lending, wealth management, and more. The page highlights real-time payment processing, digital lending and credit platforms, blockchain and smart-contract integration, and open banking/API-first architecture. It lists payment processing and digital wallet systems, digital lending/credit-decisioning platforms, open-banking and third-party financial API integrations, and audit trails, encryption and fraud-monitoring tooling. Its representative technology set is TypeScript, Node.js, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Stripe/payment APIs, Kafka, AWS.

features.title: Custom Software Development
features.answer: ZuiGO describes Custom Software Development as end-to-end custom software engineering from concept to deployment and beyond. The page highlights tailored solutions, modern technology and best practices, scalable and maintainable architecture, rapid prototyping/MVP development, and ongoing support. It lists web and mobile applications, SaaS platforms and multi-tenant systems, internal tools/dashboards/admin panels, and APIs, integrations and technical documentation. Its representative technology set is React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS.

features.title: Cloud & DevOps Solutions
features.answer: ZuiGO describes Cloud & DevOps Solutions as cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices. The page lists cloud migration and landing-zone setup, automated CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, containerization and orchestration, and 24/7 monitoring and incident response. Its representative tools are AWS, Azure, GCP, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Grafana and Prometheus.

features.title: About ZuiGO
features.answer: ZuiGO is a software solutions company focused on solving real problems by building software. The About page says it was founded by Dr. Manisha Thakkar, who has a PhD in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, published research at top-tier AI conferences, and over 10 years of industry experience. The page lists Engineering Excellence, Client-First, Innovation-Driven and Collaborative as values.

features.title: Technology information
features.answer:

features.title: Contact ZuiGO
features.answer: The ZuiGO Contact page provides a 'Send Us a Message' form with Full Name, Email Address and Message. It says ZuiGO will get back within 24 hours. The verified Contact page publishes hello@zuigo.ai.

features.title: Address / Location
features.answer: ZuiGO's official contact information identifies Pune, Maharashtra, India. The Runwal Platinum address supplied for this project is not yet published on the website, so this chatbot does not present it as an officially website-verified address. For confirmation, contact ZuiGO at hello@zuigo.ai.

features.title: Meeting / Consultation
features.answer: ZuiGO's website provides a 'Book a Free Consultation' action and service pages provide 'Book a Call'. The home page also offers 'Send us a message' and says ZuiGO will reply within 24 hours. The chatbot does not invent meeting dates or available slots; it directs the visitor to the website's booking action.

features.title: About the website
features.answer: ZuiGO presents itself as a custom software development company. Its website says it builds production software with a focus on secure, scalable systems and highlights healthcare, fintech, AI, cloud and custom engineering as its practice areas.
